title: Symrise presents Health Active & Probi® portfolios at Vitafoods Europe to deliver science‑backed wellness solutions
summary: ‒ Symrise is jointly exhibiting Health Active and Probi solutions for the first time following the launch of the Care & Wellness Division ‒ Product launches for sports and active nutrition, vascular health, and postbiotic solutions highlight scientific and innovation excellence ‒ Premier of the preconcept taste bar showcasing innovative applications to experience at the show ‒ First Exclusive Innovation Lunch to be hosted on May 5

extraction.key_fact: 심라이즈는 케어 앤 웰니스 부문 출범 이후 비타푸즈 유럽 전시회에서 헬스 액티브 및 프로비 포트폴리오를 함께 선보인다.
